LanguageData.RKU_UndergroundAssaultWeapons.label: Underground Assault Weapons
LanguageData.RKU_UndergroundAssaultWeapons.descriptio: A product born from the Partisans' experience in underground warfare, combined with the advanced industrial capabilities they themselves lack. These weapons are better suited for close-quarters combat and for rapidly closing the distance with the enemy.\nGenerally, the blueprint must be obtained through joint research with the Ratkin Underground Partisan Faction.
LanguageData.RKU_UndergroundExperimentalWeapon.label: Underground Experimental Weapons
LanguageData.RKU_UndergroundExperimentalWeapon.descri: Ancient modified fungi, discovered in extreme underground environments, possess weaponisation potential. Realizing this potential requires a joint effort between the Partisans and your colony.\nGenerally, the blueprint must be obtained through joint research with the Ratkin Underground Partisan Faction.
LanguageData.RKU_UndergroundGuerrillaEquipments.label: Underground Partisan Weapons
LanguageData.RKU_UndergroundGuerrillaEquipments.descr: A product born from the Partisans' experience in underground warfare, combined with the advanced industrial capabilities they themselves lack. These weapons are extremely lightweight yet can withstand sufficient damage, allowing the wearer to quickly close in on enemies.\nGenerally, the blueprint must be obtained through joint research with the Ratkin Underground Partisan Faction.
